    sale_df = sale_df[sale_df['CustomerID'].notna()]

    # We compute repeat rate by country: share of customers with >1 distinct order

    # A customer may appear in multiple countries; assign each customer to their modal country
    cust_country = (

        .nunique()
        .reset_index(name='order_count_in_country')
    )

    cust_orders = (
        sale_df.groupby('CustomerID')['InvoiceNo']
        .nunique()
        .reset_index(name='total_orders')
    )

    # Assign each customer to their modal country (most orders placed from)
    cust_modal_country = (
        cust_country.sort_values('order_count_in_country', ascending=False)
        .drop_duplicates(subset='CustomerID', keep='first')[['CustomerID', 'Country']]
    )

    cust_data = cust_orders.merge(cust_modal_country, on='CustomerID')
    cust_data['is_repeat'] = (cust_data['total_orders'] > 1).astype(int)

    country_stats = (
